jobDescription:
A fully remote, home-based role for a creative graduate. You'll create content for Instagram, TikTok and LinkedIn and write our monthly newsletter.

Day to day you will:

  • Draft, schedule and monitor social media posts
  • Create simple graphics in Canva and edit short videos
  • Support campaign events and webinars

Please include a cover letter and a link to your portfolio. Visa sponsorship is available for the right candidate.
